We can dive into grammar, vocabulary, idioms and phrases, or work on anything else you need help with.

pro_course_detail.description:
I have helped many students pass their job interviews. They started new jobs with higher salaries and greater job satisfaction.
Please note: It takes about one to three days to prepare for a job interview, depending on your English level. You need to research the company and learn a lot about them. You need to prepare all the interview questions with good answers during, and after our lessons to feel confident.

In these interactive classes, you will be introduced to all the language and strategies that you need to stand out in your interview. You will learn how to answer some of the toughest interview questions effectively, such as:
-  Tell me about yourself
-  General interview questions 
-  Competency questions
-  Describe your education and experience
-  Behavioral questions
-  Soft skills questions

A successful interview requires you to tell a unique story about your skills, achievements, qualifications, and personality in the work environment. I have helped many students pass their job interviews. A successful job interview is one where you can differentiate yourself from other candidates. 

This requires preparation, fluency, and confidence. You will be prepared to answer both common and unexpected questions in the interview. You will learn about the power words, verbs, and phrases needed in your interview. You will be able to apply strategies to help effectively answer every question that you will be asked. You will learn how to speak in a way that sounds "clean" and "clear". I also offer a CV-checking service included for free.

I have helped quite a few students reach their required band score! One student increased her speaking band score by 2 levels! Her review is pinned on top of my reviews. They are now able to study and work abroad. Another teenage student went from A1 - C1 in about 3 years!

You don't need to know the dictionary to reach your required band score! The speaking test requires everyday English, no need for fancy or complex words or phrases. Getting a band score of 7 or above could change your life forever! For this, you will need to use the English language creatively, using complex grammatical structures and various vocabulary. 
Having helped many IELTS students, I understand the pressure and struggles that IELTS students go through to reach their required band scores. These are predominantly students who are struggling to achieve a band 7 score either because of the speaking or writing part. The IELTS exam is life-changing in many ways and I would love to help you achieve your dreams. These customized lessons will help you reach your required band score.  

I will identify the areas where you are struggling and create an effective plan to correct those mistakes. I will be offering you some tips and strategies to make sure that you are ready to ace your exam! You will feel empowered to face the exam head-on. pro_course_detail.title: Conversation And Communication Mastery
pro_course_detail.description:
This course of lessons will enable you to communicate more effectively, clearly and directly. The new conversational skills you learn will enable you to quickly and easily produce more authentic, genuine and long-lasting relationships in the board room, the office, at school, a social event, or even when a romantic interest walks in the room. 

Having the ability to start and lead a quality conversation can be the deciding factor between success and failure. Conversation mastery is a skill which enables individuals to achieve more, develop stronger relationships and increase happiness. Moreover, if you have the ability to differentiate yourself by creating a genuine and authentic connection, then you can position yourself for success.
During these lessons, I will teach you an intuitive conversation framework to guide your future conversations. Furthermore, you will have mastered the fundamental and technical conversation skills that underlie every conversation whether it be personal or business oriented. Last but not least, I will guide you through a number of real-world exercises designed to make the lessons and learning in this course automatic, easy and unconscious.
If you've ever wanted or wished for any of the below, then this course is for you:
•	Wish you knew what to say to start a conversation?
•	Want to create stronger, more authentic relationships?
•	Want to communicate more directly and clearly?
•	Wish you could rekindle an old relationship?
•	Wish you had the confidence to ask for a raise?
•	Wish you had the confidence to stand up to someone?
•	Wish you were a better networker?
•	Wish you could better express your feelings and opinions?
•	Find yourself running out of things to say?
•	Don't know how to ask for that phone number / email?

I will teach you all of the above and so much more over a series of lessons strategically paired with quizzes, tests and exercises based on conversation techniques discovered by some of the world’s most prominent experts.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday Conversation: Make Great Impressions + Connections
pro_course_detail.description:
Everyday English for your daily communication needs. Practice and improve with an emphasis on flowing conversation around topics of interest. I will give you an extensive list to choose from and then guide the conversation when necessary, but otherwise I encourage free-flowing English discussions with feedback and coaching on how to increase fluency, expression to make a great impression.

- Do you shy away from starting conversations with English speakers even though you wish you could meet more people? 
- Perhaps you’re afraid of being rejected, ignored and feeling awkward.
- Do you feel that you have no idea on how to start a conversation or “break the ice” in English

In this conversation and communication skills course on how to start conversations you will overcome all of these problems and be able to strike up a conversation with anyone, anywhere. The course includes some very simple social skills tips and conversational openers to start meeting people today!

The course outlines how to start conversations in 4 easy ways, how to overcome fears (especially of rejection), correct confident body language, and specific examples/scenarios on how to apply the 4 ways to start conversations. I will also encourage you to come up with your own unique conversational openers to start practicing!

A key to understanding how to be successful starting conversations is that the first impression is made before you even open your mouth. As you get a hold of your mindset (internal dialogue), and body language you’ll be able to say almost anything and it will work!!

Who this course is for:
- Anyone who would like to develop powerful conversation and communication skills in English
- Anyone who would like to understand better social dynamics when starting conversations
- Anyone who would like to learn how to approach, connect and make a great first impression

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate level Spanish

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for beginners

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English Conversation Classes
pro_course_detail.description: Advanced level English conversation style classes with an native speaker from the UK.  These lessons are designed to be free flowing and fairly easy going while at the same time working your language learning skills to the full.  Any topics can be discussed as long as you find them fun and interesting,  use of news articles, movies, music, books and tv series is encouraged.

I am a teacher who will not only prepare you from a Language perspective but also from a psychological perspective.   How to show your hunger and ambition is where I come in.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I am a target and goal oriented teacher.    I work with my students based on their specific needs.

My lesson plan is always tailored to every students need.  I am very creative in changing plan and strategy based on the immediate and long term goals of my students.  

The topics we will discuss, the vocabulary or phrases used will be based on what you are trying to improve, whether its Interviews, Career, Business English, Conversational English or if you are looking to pass IELTS, TOEFL or any other test. 

Due to my broad interest in many topics, you will never be bored in our conversations.  I usually choose subjects based on my student's interests.

pro_course_detail.title: Interviews - HR |Technical | Behavioural Questions
pro_course_detail.description:
I specialise in helping professionals prepare for key interviews in their careers.   I cover the whole spectrum of interview process from HR to Technical and behavioural questions.  I help in creating and tailoring your answers, which best reflect and showcase your experience, strengths and motivations.  

I have 15 years of experience in HR and Executive hires,  where I have interviewed and selected professionals with in IT, Banking, Professional Services, E-commerce and Marketing. 

My interview coaching is also reflective of your specific situation.   Such as looking for an opportunity abroad, changing careers or industry. 

I cover all aspects of interview including Body language, appropriate and relevant terminologies based on your industry and salary negotiations.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic Interview - Graduate and Post Graduate positions
pro_course_detail.description:
My coaching in this lesson will prepare you for an academic interview you might have with any university or other institutions in the world.   I have already helped many students receive offers from their target universities such as London School of Economics (LSE), Cambridge, and MIT.

This session is suitable for all Post-graduate or Graduate programs at any institution in the world.  

We will tailor your answers in a way that it reflects your Background, its relevance to what you are applying for, your motivation behind choosing the university and your ambition and plan after completing the course.   We will showcase all these factors in different answers for various predictable questions and also look at questions which are not normally asked but can be asked.

pro_course_detail.title: Resume (Writing and Editing) | Covering Letter (writing and Editing) | Document Proofreading
pro_course_detail.description:
Across my professional career I have seen thousands of professional CVs and helped hundreds of professionals showcase their background in tailor made profiles which makes them stand out in a very saturated job market.

In this session I will coach you on how to create an ATS compliant Resume, which meets industry expectations and also helps you stand out amongst crowd. 

We will work on all aspects of resume including Content and style.  

I help create content which is to the point, highlights what is relevant to the target requirement and also intriguing to win you that interview.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation - Grammar | Vocabulary | Idioms | Phrases | Pronunciation | Accent Reduction
pro_course_detail.description:
As a Professional Native teacher, I work with my students to help them improve their level of fluency.  I target this by looking at all the gaps that need to be addressed.  

My lesson plan is tailored based on your particular needs.  We will work on Speaking/ Writing and Listening skills or the ones which need more attention at first.  The goal is to make your fluency and capability in English mistake free and with broader vocabulary.   It also needs to appropriate for the situation which we will discuss.  

I am a well read person, which means the conversation topics I choose with my students are always based around what interests them.  This makes the conversation more fun and engaging.

My Lessons for this purpose are structure around:  
Discussion on various topics depending on the level of student
Introducing students to new vocabulary, phrases and idioms relevant to the topic
Doing various exercises  
Role play .... AND .... 
There is also Homework ; )
